clock_scope: Original packet PTS/time_base is bound to decoded frame index through H.264 picture-order metadata. Decoded filter/showinfo timestamps are separately recorded; after duplicate PTS the decoder mostly used DTS-based best-effort values. No authoritative media-PTS-to-UTC or media-PTS-to-XCTest anchor is established.
derivation_note: Exactly one ffmpeg picture decode completed exit 0 and retained84 PNGs. The original postprocess parser assumed an older showinfo format and failed; preserved logs were reparsed without another decode. Original packet/frame binding then used SPS/PPS/slice-header picture order metadata only. Sampling was based on actual filter timestamps, not original packet PTS; do not label this as dense original-media14–22s coverage.
